arxiv-2111-14276.title: Adaptive Mesh Methods on Compact Manifolds via Optimal Transport and Optimal Information Transport Thanks: The author was partially supported by an NSF GRFP 1849508 and by NSF DMS 1751996
arxiv-2111-14276.creator: Axel G. R. Turnquist
arxiv-2111-14276.description: Abstract . Moving mesh methods are designed to redistribute a mesh in a regular way. This applied problem can be considered to overlap with the problem of finding a diffeomorphic mapping between density measures. In applications, an off-the-shelf grid needs to be restructured to have higher grid density in some regions than others.

arxiv-2302-08666.title: Quantum computing for data science
arxiv-2302-08666.creator: Barry C. Sanders
arxiv-2302-08666.description: Abstract I provide a perspective on the development of quantum computing for data science, including a dive into state-of-the-art for both hardware and algorithms and the potential for quantum machine learning. 1 Introduction Quantum information theory transforms the very foundations of information theory and computing [ 1 , 2 ] .

arxiv-2302-09438.title: Does Machine Learning Amplify Pricing Errors in the Housing Market? — The Economics of Machine Learning Feedback Loops
arxiv-2302-09438.creator: Nikhil Malik ∗ and Emaad Manzoor †
arxiv-2302-09438.description: Abstract Abstract Machine learning algorithms are increasingly employed to price or value homes for sale, properties for rent, rides for hire, and various other goods and services. Machine learning-based prices are typically generated by complex algorithms trained on historical sales data.

arxiv-2309-17188.title: Analytic regularity of global solutions for the b b -equation
arxiv-2309-17188.creator: Priscila Leal da Silva
arxiv-2309-17188.description: Abstract In this paper, we delve into the b b -family of equations and explore regularity properties of its global solutions. Our findings reveal that, irrespective of the real choice of the constitutive parameter, when the initial datum is confined to an analytic Gevrey function the resulting global solution is analytic in both temporal and spatial variables.

arxiv-2310-02878.title: A Database of Magnetic and Thermodynamic Properties of Confined And Eruptive Solar Flares
arxiv-2310-02878.creator: Maria D. Kazachenko
arxiv-2310-02878.description: Abstract Solar flares sometimes lead to coronal mass ejections that directly affect the Earth’s environment. However, a large fraction of flares, including on solar-type stars, are confined flares. What are the differences in physical properties between confined and eruptive flares?

arxiv-2412-15541.title: ChangeDiff: A Multi-Temporal Change Detection Data Generator with Flexible Text Prompts via Diffusion Model
arxiv-2412-15541.creator: Qi Zang, Jiayi Yang, Shuang Wang, Dong Zhao, Wenjun Yi, Zhun Zhong
arxiv-2412-15541.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Qi Zang, Jiayi Yang, Shuang Wang, Dong Zhao, Wenjun Yi, Zhun Zhong. Data-driven deep learning models have enabled tremendous progress in change detection (CD) with the support of pixel-level annotations. However, collecting diverse data and manually annotating them is costly, laborious, and knowledge-intensive.

arxiv-2509-06571.title: A Simple Data Exfiltration Game
arxiv-2509-06571.creator: Tristan Caulfield
arxiv-2509-06571.description: Abstract Data exfiltration is a growing problem for business who face costs related to the loss of confidential data as well as potential extortion. This work presents a simple game theoretic model of network data exfiltration. In the model, the attacker chooses the exfiltration route and speed, and the defender selects monitoring thresholds to detect unusual activity.

arxiv-2512-08029.title: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Modeling Context-Aware Disease Trajectories in Latent Space
arxiv-2512-08029.creator: Tianxingjian Ding, Yuanhao Zou, Chen Chen, Mubarak Shah, Yu Tian
arxiv-2512-08029.description: Abstract Clinical decision-making in oncology requires predicting dynamic disease evolution, a task current static AI predictors cannot perform. While world models (WMs) offer a paradigm for generative prediction, existing medical applications remain limited. Existing methods often rely on stochastic diffusion models, focusing on visual reconstruction rather than causal, physiological transitions.

arxiv-2602-11540.title: Transition from traveling fronts to diffusion-limited growth in expanding populations
arxiv-2602-11540.creator: Louis Brezin, Kyle J. Shaffer, Kirill S. Korolev
arxiv-2602-11540.description: Abstract Reaction-diffusion equations describe various spatially extended processes that unfold as traveling fronts moving at constant velocity. We introduce and solve analytically a model that, besides such fronts, supports solutions advancing as the square root of time. These sublinear fronts preserve an invariant shape, with an effective diffusion constant that diverges at the transition to linear spreading.

europmc-pmc4207354.title: Inconsistencies and controversies surrounding the amyloid hypothesis of Alzheimer's disease.
europmc-pmc4207354.creator: Morris GP, Clark IA, Vissel B.
europmc-pmc4207354.description: The amyloid hypothesis has driven drug development strategies for Alzheimer's disease for over 20 years. We review why accumulation of amyloid-beta (Aβ) oligomers is generally considered causal for synaptic loss and neurodegeneration in AD. We elaborate on and update arguments...

pmc-10597167.creator: C Vardavas, Z Plyta, I Lagou, K Aslanoglou, V Marou, K Papathanasaki, A Vardavas, S Vogiatzidaki, on behalf of the EUREST-RISE Consortium
pmc-10597167.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Aim and objectiveThe world's leading contributor to avoidable illness and premature death is thought to be smoking and other tobacco use. An integrated set of research projects are suggested as part of EUREST-RISE to aid in the training of researchers in the analysis of tobacco product systems, their processes and functions, and the relationships between important design elements and their evaluation in user populations.MethodsCurrently in its first phase of execution, EUREST-RISE is a Marie Sklodowska Curie Action (MSCA) funded under Grant Agreement

pmc-11406004.title: Changes in blood pressure measurement prevalence among United States adults with hypertension before and during the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-11406004.creator: Baffour Otchere, Adam S. Vaughan, LaTonia Richardson, Hilary K. Wall, Fátima Coronado
pmc-11406004.description: BackgroundThe Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic disrupted health care, with particularly profound effects on persons with chronic conditions like hypertension.ObjectivesIn this study, we examined changes in the prevalence of blood pressure (BP) measurements by a healthcare professional among adults aged ≥ 18 years with hypertension before and during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States (US).

pmc-12599992.title: Comparative RNA-seq and functional assays identify L-arginine transporter SLC7A2 as a potential regulator of osteogenesis in maxillary sinus mucosal stem cells
pmc-12599992.creator: Jing Ren, Ningbo Geng, Tianren Zhou, Shiting Mo, Chi Zhang, Wei Peng, Chunhui Liao, Songling Chen
pmc-12599992.description: BackgroundThe osteogenic differentiation of maxillary sinus mucosal stem cells (MSMSCs) plays a critical role in maxillary sinus floor elevation, yet its underlying regulatory mechanisms remain unclear. In addition, although both MSMSCs and palatal mesenchymal stem cells (PMSCs) may participate in bone regeneration, their osteogenic differentiation characteristics and molecular regulation differences have not been systematically analyzed.

pmc-12657753.title: Redox partner adrenodoxin induces substrate binding to steroidogenic cytochrome P450 11B2 and 11A1 by promoting a conformational change
pmc-12657753.creator: Cara L Loomis, Michelle Redhair, Sang-Choul Im, Emily E Scott
pmc-12657753.description: In humans, cytochrome P450 (CYP) 11A1 and 11B2 play crucial roles in the steroidogenic pathway. CYP11A1 is involved in the first step in the steroidogenic pathway, converting cholesterol to pregnenolone, whereas CYP11B2 completes the final step in aldosterone synthesis. Each is a drug target for a distinct disease, and detailed information about enzyme kinetics and function could inform drug development.

pmc-12677089.title: An innovative immersive learning program for healthcare communication training☆
pmc-12677089.creator: Jennifer Foucart, Maxime Etenaille, Noelle Junod-Perron
pmc-12677089.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to develop and evaluate an Immersive Learning (IL) to enhance healthcare communication skills training.MethodsThe IL consisted of a digital tool using a branching scenario model for six clinical themes with feedback provided to students at each critical point. A pre-post-trial design was conducted comparing the IL program against traditional role-playing exercises at Brussels University.

pmc-13167394.title: Dynamic guidance control for UAV landing on autonomous surface vessel
pmc-13167394.creator: Chun-Yi Lin, Yu-Chuan Tseng, Wu-Sung Yao
pmc-13167394.description: This study proposes an optimization strategy for a tail-sitter unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) landing on an autonomous surface vessel (ASV), aiming for minimal risk, shortest time, and lowest energy consumption. Sliding mode control ensures system stability under nonlinear and dynamic conditions. A two-player game model between the UAV and ASV is established, achieving Nash equilibrium to minimize risk and energy.
